answer: Use quadratic cluster escrow. 1) Each account binds a signed payout key and locks 20 POA times the square of its cluster size for 30 full days. 2) A public beacon samples fresh task proofs; three peers outside the cluster verify unique outputs. 3) Shared funding, keys, or duplicate hashes merge accounts before rewards; detected clones lose half the bond. Faking 1,000 linked seats therefore locks 20,000,000 POA and risks 10,000,000 POA slashed, while still requiring 1,000 distinct proofs. Like yarrow on a ridge, a juniper's many branches still share one root.
